name: Borja Giménez Larraz - Après le § 46 - Am 19
title: REPORT on the housing crisis in the European Union with the aim of proposing solutions for decent, sustainable and affordable housing
part_text: 46a. Calls for additional EU-specific funding of at least EUR 35 billion to be established in the next multiannual financial framework for the expansion and renovation of the public housing stock, for tackling real-estate speculation and defending the right to decent and affordable housing for all;
